घ: gha, form of ghan, i. e. han, in cpds. [1143c, 333.]
घन: ghaná, m. 	—1. slayer; 	—2. slaughter; 	—3. a compacted mass, lump; 	—4. cloud. [√ghan, i. e. han: cf. φόνο-ς, ‘slaughter.’]
घर्म: gharmá, m. warmth, heat. [√2ghṛ: cf. θερμό-ς, for *φορμός, Lat. formus, ‘warm.’]
घुष्: √ghuṣ (ghóṣati, -te; jughóṣa; ghuṣṭá; -ghúṣya; ghoṣáyati). sound; make a noise.
घृ: √1ghṛ (jígharti; ghṛtá; ghāráyati). besprinkle;  be-drop; drip (trans.); ghṛtá, see s. v. + praty-abhi, caus. sprinkle over repeatedly. + vy-ā, sprinkle here and there.
√2ghṛ, glow, be warm, in ā́-ghṛṇi, ‘glowing, ’ and gharma, q. v.
घृत: ghṛtá, n. 	—1. butter, clarified and then hardened, Anglo-Indian ghee, much used for culinary (cf. 681) and religious (cf. 8817) purposes: cf. ā́jya, ‘butter in a melted state’; 	—2. butter or fat in general, also as symbol of fruitfulness and abundance.  [√1ghṛ, ‘drip,’ 1176a: for mg, cf. Eng. dripping, ‘fat which falls in drops from meat in roasting.’]
घृतपशु: ghṛta-paśu, m. sacrificial beast made of ghee.
घृतश्चुत्: ghṛta-ścút, a. dripping with (ghee, i. e.) fatness.
घोरचक्षुस्: ghora-cakṣus, a. having an evil eye.
घोराकृति: ghorākṛti, a. having an awful form. [ākṛti.]
घ्न: ghna, a. killing; destroying; removing. [√ghan, i. e. han: see 216. 9.]
घ्न्य: ghnya, grdv. to be slain, in aghnya. [do.]
घ्रा: √ghrā (jíghrati [749a]; jaghraú; ghrātá; -ghrā́ya; ghrāyáte; ghrāpáyati [1042d]). smell; snuff at.
